# Question

# Solution
```sql
-- Calculate the total revenue generated by each facility
SELECT
    facilities.name,

    -- Calculate revenue for each booking first,
    -- then add all booking revenues for the facility
    SUM(
        CASE
            -- Guest bookings (memid = 0) use guestcost
            WHEN bookings.memid = 0
                THEN bookings.slots * facilities.guestcost

            -- Member bookings use membercost
            ELSE bookings.slots * facilities.membercost
        END
    ) AS revenue

FROM cd.bookings AS bookings

-- Add facility information to every booking
JOIN cd.facilities AS facilities
    ON bookings.facid = facilities.facid

-- Collapse all bookings belonging to the same facility
GROUP BY facilities.name

-- Display the facilities from lowest to highest revenue
ORDER BY revenue;
```
